displayPattern: Status LED: 4 short flashes then 6 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: Brownout event: low line voltage reaching the unit. Reset time is 6 minutes.
causes: Bad connection on L1 and L2
diySteps: Technician: check for line voltage of more than approximately 180 V; if it is less than 180 V and persists, contact the power provider
Technician: check the connections on the line and load side; if nothing else is found, replace the inverter
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician, and your power provider if the supply voltage is persistently low.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
